jobSearch.title: Search and apply for jobs on Job Bank
jobSearch.body: Browse job postings that match your skills and apply directly through Job Bank.

eiApply.title: Apply for Employment Insurance
eiApply.body: Apply for EI benefits online as soon as you stop working — even if you don't have your ROE yet, applying right away avoids delaying your first payment.

eiReport.title: Submit your EI report every two weeks
eiReport.body: Once your claim is active, complete your EI report every two weeks — even if you have no income to report — or your payments will stop.
